# Vendored libraries

- `nordic-lib-kicad/`: Nordic Semiconductor KiCad symbols, footprints and 3D models, copied as plain files from https://github.com/hlord2000/nordic-lib-kicad at commit 05a4dae2427fde6be0e190d6c9169eae1b3dae51. Its own submodules were never fetched and are not included. To update, copy a newer checkout over it without its `.git` and change the commit here.
